About.intro: Kbell & Postman is a small, senior studio in Amsterdam. We take products from idea to production — strategy, design, and code — for teams whose ideas have outgrown their in-house capacity.
About.capabilitiesBody: Four disciplines in one studio. Specialists join when the brief needs them. Keep scrolling here: the capability cards move sideways, then the page continues.
About.testimonialsHeadline: Don’t take our words for it

t1.quote: We came to Kbell & Postman with a vibe-coded prototype and a deadline. Six weeks later we had a production app, EU-hosted, paying customers on it. They act like a co-founder, not a vendor.
t1.name: Marijn de Vries

t2.quote: They turned a fuzzy product brief into something our team could actually test. The work felt senior from the first call: clear scope, calm decisions, and no theatre.
t2.name: Lotte Bakker

t3.quote: The biggest difference was momentum. We stopped debating abstractions and started reviewing a working product every week. That changed the whole client conversation.
t3.name: Samir El Idrissi

t4.quote: They understood that this wasn't a design refresh. It was an operational surgery.
t4.name: Head of Accreditation

t5.quote: The platform made cultural research easier to explore, explain, and use in strategy work.
t5.name: Strategy lead

About.ctaHeadline: Not sure which capability you need? Tell us the problem.

WhoYouWorkWith.body: You always work directly with Karissa and Alex — the two of us run KB+PM, and have for seven years. When a project needs more hands, we scale up with trusted specialists who already know how we work — without ever adding an account layer between you and the work.

karissa.note: 15+ years as a UI/UX designer, across fashion, branding, advertising, recruitment, marketing and research. Shapes the brief, pressure-tests the product direction, and keeps the work close to the business goal.
karissa.imageAlt: Karissa — product, strategy, and client lead

alex.note: 20+ years as a development lead, across advertising and real estate. Turns the direction into a working product, with the technical decisions needed to keep it useful after launch.

Services.indexHeadline: Choose where the product needs help.
Services.ctaHeadline: Not sure which model fits your project?

validate.body: For teams who need confidence before design or development starts. We help define the right problem, test the idea, and map what is worth building.
validate.listIntro: Useful when the brief is still forming.
validate.when: You need clarity before investing in design or development.
validate.goal: Direction before you commit to building.
validate.panelIntro: Audits, workshops and feasibility work — so you know what to build before you spend on it.
validate.outcome: A clear direction and a plan you can act on.

build.body: For teams who know what to make and need a senior team to design and develop it. From prototype to platform — we ship focused increments toward product-market fit.
build.listIntro: Useful when the product needs to become real.
build.when: You know what to make and need a senior team to design and develop it.
build.panelIntro: From prototype to platform — we design and develop the product end to end.
build.outcome: A working digital product ready for real users.

evolve.body: For live products that need sharper features, better performance, smarter AI, clearer data, or a more useful experience for real users.
evolve.listIntro: Useful when the product is live but not finished.
evolve.when: Your product is live and you want to keep improving it.
evolve.goal: Improve a product that's already in use.
evolve.panelIntro: Features, AI, performance and analytics — for products that are already live.
evolve.outcome: A product that keeps getting better.

support.body: For products that need continuity after launch: maintenance, hosting, documentation, security, and senior technical judgement when it matters.
support.listIntro: Useful when the product needs to stay healthy.
support.when: You need a trusted technical partner to keep everything running.
support.goal: Keep the product stable, secure and supported.
support.panelIntro: Maintenance, hosting, emergencies and fractional CTO — so nothing gets neglected after launch.
support.outcome: A stable, secure product you don't have to babysit.
